tau_s.source: prior from reviews; fit by hazard model on published retention

theta.source: prior; set to P90 of max D on target videos

wps.source: tone study: Fireship 3.5, Drinker 3.0-3.3 words/s inside phrases

laugh_floor_per_min.source: 2026-11-05 SEEN calibration (calibration/failures/security-week-r1/proposal.json): approved Altman roast dry-run 4.29 (K variants 4.19-4.37), altman-ram 3.81 (3.65-4.00); rejected security-week r1 dry-run 2.71 (2.61-2.84), security-week 2.37 (2.29-2.45). The floor stays at the Fireship P25 of calibration run 3 (2.99), which lies in the gap. The old ceiling 4.13 is dropped: the approved film's SEEN read is 4.29 and no rejected film was ever too funny.

min_fact_laugh_share.source: measurement review. 2026-11-05 SEEN pair does not separate on it: approved Altman 0.333 dry-run / 0.314 altman-ram (K variants 0.304-0.338), rejected security-week r1 0.286 / 0.286 (0.286-0.300); the gap is one bit of r1's 21 laughs and the approved film fails 0.5 itself. Advisory (G5f) until a sample separates it.

follow_seconds_share.source: measurement review; kept by the 2026-11-05 SEEN calibration: approved Altman 100% / 100% followed, no lost run, no weak retell unit; rejected security-week r1 96% dry-run but 67% for its topic audience, lost run 4, 5 retell units under 0.6. G4 separates on the topic audience only.

cringe_veto_p.source: calibration: second-family juror on 144 labelled seed lines, AUC 0.979; at 0.4 recall 0.92, false alarms 2% on real jokes and 2% on flat (calibration/juror-seed.jsonl)

peak.source: calibration run 1: P95 of E[laugh+½smile] over all target units is 0.50; every Fireship video has a mid-40% unit at 0.44-0.62

end.source: calibration run 1: best reference ending (N2TmzjbmjGM) has mean net +0.16 over its last 20 s; all Fireship endings are -0.32 to +0.03; take five -0.27

callback_min_gap_frac.source: Inso's ruling 2026-11-09: the callback gap scales with the film, min(callback_min_gap_s, this share of the runtime); every film of 200 s or longer is judged as before

advisory_gates.source: 2026-11-05, Inso's yes to the security-week r1 proposal (calibration/failures/security-week-r1/proposal.json): G4 and G5 are hard, fitted on SEEN reads; the juror's cringe veto is advisory on meme bits until Inso rules on its meme calibration (it was fitted on lines with no memes); the fact-laugh share is advisory because the SEEN pair does not separate on it.

laugh_cut.source: calibration run 1: P(laugh)+0.5 P(smile) >= 0.2 gives best F1 0.65 (precision 0.68, recall 0.63) against human joke labels on 8 reference videos

cringe_source.v: juror where it read the bit, else Jev
cringe_source.source: juror cringe AUC 0.979 on seed lines; Jev cringe over-calls (14/48 cringe rewrites as lands) and reads 0.3+ on bits the juror calls clean

juror_cringe_map.source: isotonic fit of juror cringe score to the cringe label on 144 seed lines; calibration/juror-cringe-map.json

laugh_floor_audiences.source: the floor comes from Fireship references read with the channel card; a topic persona has no on-topic reference to fit a floor from

entertainment.source: 2026-11-05, G12 at the SEEN stage, each threshold the midpoint between the approved Altman roast SEEN read and the rejected security-week r1 SEEN read (n = 1 + 1; calibration/failures/security-week-r1/proposal.json). Landed laughs/min (bits with laugh + 0.5 smile >= laugh_cut): Altman 7.04 / 6.85 (K variants >= 6.75), r1 5.18 / 5.18 (<= 5.18). Library memes/min: Altman 1.86 (19 in 613.5 s), r1 1.48 (6 in 243.3 s). Longest voice run without a laugh or smile: Altman 14.3 s, r1 17.6 s. Meme time shown full, cutout or ghost (seen 'display'): Altman 64%, r1 50%. Whole-cut juror keep-watching, min over audiences of 3 draws: Altman 0.52 (altman-ram; dry-run 0.60), r1 0.41 (security-week; dry-run 0.72, above Altman: the juror does not separate the films for the channel audience, and the 10-minute film is read against a 4-minute one).
